subject: phase3_dvc_post_repair_calibration
statement: Close the post-repair DVC calibration without scored-pilot promotion and repair result publication plus taskpack scope inference before another live benchmark.
selected_option: retain all three outcomes as calibration evidence, reject promotion, and prepare provider-free runtime repairs

alternatives.option: promote because full mode launched implementation
alternatives.rejected_reason: Launching implementation verifies the stage-reserve mechanism but produced no valid scored candidate.

alternatives.option: classify direct and full as model-quality failures
alternatives.rejected_reason: Direct lost a completed semantic result during terminal reconciliation, while full was bounded by an incomplete generated write scope.

alternatives.option: rerun immediately with a larger token budget
alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed failures are deterministic runtime-contract defects, and another live run would spend provider tokens before those defects are repaired.

rationale: The run completed the frozen three-mode sequence with complete usage accounting. Dynamic L2 tool routing, deterministic grounding reuse, and full-mode stage reservation worked. However, direct and full published empty candidates despite retained worker patches, total usage reached 2788487 tokens, and the framework exposed result-reconciliation, artifact-modeling, and cross-layer scope defects. These findings do not support promotion or another unmodified live run.
expected_outcome: Provider-free tests prove mailbox semantic preservation, typed expected artifacts, and cross-layer write-scope completion before any new provider-backed calibration is authorized.
acceptance_refs: all four provider invocations have complete reported usage
no scored pilot authorization was emitted
